# Application package (generated by Notebook 06)

Machine-readable outlook for the Spring Boot backend + React frontend.

- `latest_forecast.json` — canonical contract (system + forecast + summary).
- `blocks.json` — static block metadata (Bhuvan IDs, centroids).
- `sangrur_blocks.geojson` — static geometry (WGS84), no forecast values embedded.
- `metadata.json` — package provenance. `api/` — Spring Boot fixtures.
- `docs/api/` — endpoint + schema documentation.

Forecast science is frozen upstream (NB01–NB05); this package only repackages it.
